source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the nitrogen cycle and its Tidbit, printed pages 232-234.

blocks.text: Nitrogen Cycle ek pecheeda amal hai jis ke zariye nitrogen ecosystem ke biotic (zinda) aur abiotic (be-jaan) hisson ke darmiyan ghoomti rehti hai. Is mein hawa ki nitrogen (N₂) aise compounds mein badalti hai jinhein jandar istemal kar saken, aur baad mein N₂ wapas hawa mein chali jati hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Water cycle aisi cheez (paani) ko chalata hai jo humein nazar aati hai, jabke Nitrogen Cycle ek na-nazar aane wali gas se ta'alluq rakhta hai jo hamari hawa (atmosphere) ka taqreeban 78% hai.
Nitrogen cycle ek musalsal daire (loop) mein chalta hai aur in paanch zaroori qadmon (steps) se guzarta hai:
1. Nitrogen Fixation (nitrogen ka mitti mein aana)

Hawa mein 78% nitrogen gas (N₂) hai. Is ke do atoms ek mazboot triple bond (teen-gana bond) se jure hote hain jise paude nahin tor sakte. Nitrogen fixation woh amal hai jis mein N₂ ko ammonia (NH₃) jaise inorganic compounds mein badla jata hai. Yeh teen tareeqon se hota hai:

items: Biological Fixation (jandaron ke zariye): Kul nitrogen fixation ka 90% se zyada mitti ke microorganisms (khurdbeeni jandar) karte hain. Nitrogen fix karne wale microorganisms do qism ke hain: (i) free-living (non-symbiotic, akele rehne wale), jaise cyanobacteria ya blue-green algae, Azotobacter aur Clostridium; aur (ii) mutualistic (symbiotic, saath reh kar dono ko faida dene wale) bacteria, jaise Rhizobium, jo chana (chickpeas) ya moong (mung beans) jaise bohat se daalon wale (legume) paudon ki jarhon ki gaanthon (root nodules) mein rehte hain. Yeh microorganisms mitti mein maujood hawa se seedha nitrogen "fix" kar ke ammonia bana dete hain.

Atmospheric Fixation (bijli ke zariye): Barish aur toofan ke dauran asmani bijli (lightning) itni zyada tawanai deti hai ke hawa ki nitrogen oxygen se mil jati hai. Is tarah N₂ pehle nitrogen oxides aur phir nitrates mein badal jati hai. Is tareeqe se sirf thori si (5-10%) nitrogen fix hoti hai.
Industrial fixation (karkhanon mein): Nitrogen wali khaad (fertilizers) banane ko industrial fixation kehte hain. Is amal mein hawa ki nitrogen aur hydrogen ko mila kar ammonia banayi jati hai.

blocks.alt: Hawa ki nitrogen gas ko jarhon ki gaanthon (root nodules) aur mitti ke nitrogen-fixing bacteria fix kar ke ammonium banate hain. Paude janwaron (khargosh) ki ghiza; dono decomposer bacteria aur fungi tak jaate jo ammonium banate (ammonification). Nitrifying bacteria nitrites phir nitrates banate (nitrification). Nitrates paudon mein (assimilation) ya denitrifying bacteria se wapas nitrogen gas (denitrification).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bayen taraf hawa ki N2 do raaston se fix hoti hai: jarhon ki gaanthon ke bacteria aur mitti ke azad bacteria. Neeche ammonium se nitrites aur nitrates bante hain (nitrifying bacteria). Nitrates ya to paude le lete hain (assimilation) ya denitrifying bacteria unhein wapas N2 bana kar hawa mein bhej dete hain. Kitab mein 'fingi' chhapa hai; sahi lafz fungi hai.

Ammonia zyada miqdar mein aksar zehreeli hoti hai ya paude ise aasani se istemal nahin kar sakte. Mitti ke bacteria (jaise Nitrosomonas aur Nitrobacter) ise badalne ka kaam karte hain. Nitrosomonas ammonia ko nitrite (NO₂⁻) mein badalte hain, aur Nitrobacter is nitrite ko nitrate (NO₃⁻) mein. Paude nitrates ko aasani se jazb kar lete hain.
3. Assimilation (nitrogen ka jandaron mein dakhil hona)

Assimilation woh amal hai jis mein paude aur microbes mitti se nitrates jazb karte hain aur un se proteins, DNA aur chlorophyll banate hain. Janwar paude aur doosre janwar kha kar nitrogen hasil (assimilate) karte hain.

Jab paude aur janwar marte hain, ya janwar nitrogen wala fuzla (nitrogenous waste) chhorte hain, to decomposers (fungi aur bacteria, yaani galane sarane wale jandar) pecheeda proteins ko tor dete hain. Woh organic nitrogen ko wapas ammonia mein badal dete hain.
5. Denitrification (nitrogen ka wapas hawa mein jana)

Chakkar ka tawazun (balance) qaim rakhne ke liye nitrogen ko aakhir kaar wapas hawa mein jana hota hai. Paani se bhari (waterlogged) mitti mein denitrifying bacteria (jaise Pseudomonas aur Thiobacillus) nitrates ko wapas nitrogen gas (N₂) mein badal dete hain, jo phir hawa mein chali jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Kisan chana jaise daalon wale (legume) paude doosri faslon ke saath baari baari kyun ugate hain?
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke in ki jarhon ki gaanthon (root nodules) mein Rhizobium bacteria hawa ki nitrogen ko ammonia mein fix karte hain, is se mitti mein paudon ke kaam aane wali nitrogen barh jati hai.

items: Fixation: biological (90% se zyada; Azotobacter, Clostridium, cyanobacteria, Rhizobium), atmospheric (bijli, 5-10%), industrial (khaad).
Nitrification: Nitrosomonas ammonia → nitrite (NO₂⁻); Nitrobacter nitrite → nitrate (NO₃⁻).
Assimilation (nitrates se proteins, DNA, chlorophyll), ammonification (decomposers → ammonia), denitrification (Pseudomonas, Thiobacillus → N₂).
